task: BL-13 (R5) — conversion of retired Alpha.5 tool-family golden vectors
note: Regression comparison input only. The old vectors were recorded under the retired tool-family execution path; they are NOT new acceptance evidence and a MATCH pins only what the new lane must not silently change.

vectors.effectClaim: read({file_path:'caf\u00e9.txt'}) resolved to the in-root file resource `file:caf\u00e9.txt` with the NFC spelling preserved (no Unicode normalization).
vectors.derivation: The new lane does not consume the old resource key, so the convertible claim is the path's locator identity: the same path must yield the same segments and the same relativeness under `toLocatorKey`. The old fingerprint (sha256:8c05\u2026) is deliberately NOT carried.

vectors.effectClaim: read({file_path:'cafe\u0301.txt'}) stayed a DISTINCT resource (`file:cafe\u0301.txt`) from the NFC spelling; no normalization was applied.
vectors.derivation: Converted as the locator-identity claim: the NFD spelling must produce a distinct comparison key (combining mark kept as its own codepoint in the segment), while relativeness is unchanged. The old fingerprint is not carried.

vectors.effectClaim: read({file_path:'../escape.txt'}) resolved to `file:../escape.txt`: the leading `..` was kept as authored and never folded away.
vectors.derivation: Converted as the `..`-never-folds locator claim, which the old recorded key and the P1-03 containment law agree on. The fingerprint is not carried.

vectors.effectClaim: read({file_path:'/etc/outside.txt'}) was recorded as an ABSOLUTE path outside the root (`file:/etc/outside.txt`), not as a relative in-root path.
vectors.derivation: Converted as the new lane's lane decision for that same locator against a restricted allow of `/work`: an absolute outside locator must be `deny`. This is a derived effect claim, not the old fingerprint; the recorded vector only supplies the path shape.

vectors.effectClaim: A read call was addressed by a sha256 `canonicalizeOperation` fingerprint over (tool, arguments, resolver-disclosed resource); the full corpus digest was the gate.
vectors.oldSemantics: Changed invariant: durable read grant identity is no longer derived from an operation projection. The new lane compiles `EffectiveIo` and consumes a one-shot invocation capability; `canonicalizeOperation` has zero importers in member-io-policy / team-services / team-sandbox (measured), so no fingerprint addresses a managed call. The 2893-vector digest cannot be replayed as a new-lane effect.

vectors.effectClaim: A bash command STRING was canonicalized (quoting, unicode, cwd, effect fields) into a fingerprint that addressed durable shell approvals.
vectors.oldSemantics: Changed invariant: no shell string is an execution input. The new OS runner takes an explicit non-empty argv and refuses `EMPTY_ARGV` with the detail 'argv must be an explicit, non-empty array (never a shell string)' (runner.ts:66); shell interpretation belongs to the native bash tool (BL-17, matrix NOT_WIRED). The command-string projection is deliberately dead.

source.producer: A5-SRGP control face: the shipped grep-port row's argv, pinned verbatim

vectors.effectClaim: The retired search-family synthesized the exact `rg` argv (including the `-rIn` quirks and the `-rl` splice) for a grep call.
vectors.oldSemantics: Changed invariant: argv synthesis is not an OS-runner responsibility. The new lane's OS runner executes an explicit argv it is handed, and the native grep row owns its own argv (BL-16, matrix NOT_WIRED). Pinning the old family spelling as a new-lane requirement would resurrect the retired row builder, so the spelling retires with it.

source.producer: u7-f web_fetch C1 positive (ask + approval, bytes delivered)

vectors.effectClaim: web_fetch with ask + approval delivered bytes and the leg saw the declared effect set; this was counted as a web-family success.
vectors.oldSemantics: Changed invariant: admission-only is not a network hard ceiling. The new lane enforces network as a boolean hard ceiling and refuses destination-restricted as UNSUPPORTED; the old ask+approval delivery is neither network enforcement nor new-lane evidence, so the vector retires instead of pinning delivery.

vectors.effectClaim: read_image({file_path}) projected a resource key only, over every path class.
vectors.oldSemantics: No equivalent: the new lane has no bound attachment/image provider (matrix M-04 NOT_WIRED; the attachment store sits outside the Member I/O model), so there is no new-lane effect to compare against the old projection.

source.producer: a5p5 parity matrix (direct backend vs C-PROC contract stub)

vectors.effectClaim: For the same effect, the direct backend and a C-PROC contract stub produced the same `effectFingerprint`, settlement and spill decision under `RequestedEffectSet`.
vectors.oldSemantics: No equivalent: the new lane forbids re-introducing `RequestedEffectSet` and has no stub-backend parity surface; the family pipeline that this matrix compared is retired. There is nothing in the new lane for the parity claim to be compared against.
